steps.title: Only text, no image
steps.text: The build filled the template's `{{info}}` with ``. Treated as HTML, that string would create an image that fails to load and then runs `alert(1)`. Here it shows up as text: the page has no ``, and no alert appeared.
steps.textZh: 构建时往模板的 `{{info}}` 里填入了 ``。如果被当成 HTML，这个字符串会生成一张加载失败的图片，随即运行 `alert(1)`。这里它只显示为文字：页面上没有 ``，也没有弹出提示框。

steps.title: What the file really says
steps.titleZh: 文件里实际写的是什么
steps.text: Double braces escape the value. Escaping turns characters such as `<` into codes such as `<`: in `dist/index.html`, `<` became `<`, `>` became `>` and `=` became `=`. The browser shows those codes as the characters, but never reads them as a tag. This step fetches the page's own file and prints that line.
steps.textZh: 双花括号会转义值。转义就是把 `<` 这样的字符换成 `<` 这样的编码：在 `dist/index.html` 里，`<` 变成了 `<`，`>` 变成了 `>`，`=` 变成了 `=`。浏览器把这些编码显示成对应的字符，但绝不会把它们当成标签来读。这一步会获取页面自己的文件，打印这一行。

steps.title: What triple braces would build
steps.text: Triple braces, `{{{info}}}`, insert the value as HTML on purpose. To see what that would build without running anything, this step parses the same string with `DOMParser`. The document it makes is inert: its images are not loaded and its handlers never run.
steps.textZh: 三花括号 `{{{info}}}` 会有意把值当作 HTML 插入。为了在不运行任何代码的前提下看看会生成什么，这一步用 `DOMParser` 解析同一个字符串。它生成的文档是惰性的：里面的图片不会加载，处理函数也永远不会运行。

action.run: const doc = new DOMParser().parseFromString('', 'text/html'); console.log('elements built:', doc.body.children.length); console.log(doc.body.innerHTML)

steps.actionLabelZh: 把字符串当作 HTML 解析

steps.title: The precompiled template
steps.text: `Handlebars.precompile` turned the same template into JavaScript, saved as `dist/template.cjs`. It needs only `handlebars/runtime`, the part of Handlebars that runs templates. No page loads it, but this step fetches it and shows the call that does the escaping.
steps.textZh: `Handlebars.precompile` 把同一个模板转换成 JavaScript，保存为 `dist/template.cjs`。它只依赖 `handlebars/runtime`，也就是 Handlebars 中负责运行模板的那部分。没有页面加载它；这一步会获取它，并找出负责转义的那次调用。

action.run: fetch('template.cjs').then((r) => r.text()).then((t) => { console.log('template.cjs needs:', t.match(/require\("([^"]+)"\)/)[1]); console.log('template.cjs calls escapeExpression:', t.includes('escapeExpression(')); })
